channel.title: Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) Industrial Control Systems (ICS) — recent CVEs
channel.description: Most recent CVEs assigned by Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) Industrial Control Systems (ICS) (icscert).

item.title: CVE-2026-71189 · 4.8 MEDIUM — Toptech TMS7 and TopHAT Cross-site Scripting
item.description: An attacker can construct a request that, if issued by another application user, will cause JavaScript code supplied by the attacker to execute within the user's browser in the context of that user's session with the application.

item.title: CVE-2026-69662 · 3.7 LOW — Toptech TMS7 and TopHAT Eval Injection
item.description: The application uses unsafe functions that allow execution of inline scripts and string evaluation functions.

item.title: CVE-2026-71302 · 7.5 HIGH 🌩️ — Toptech TMS7 and TopHAT Session Fixation
item.description: The application accepts user-supplied session identifiers and does not regenerate the session ID after authentication. This allows an attacker to predefine a session ID and reuse it after victim authentication, resulting in session takeover.

item.title: CVE-2026-72507 · 9 CRITICAL — Toptech TMS7 and TopHAT SQL Injection
item.description: The "reportType" parameter in the product summary report feature within the balancing reports section is susceptible to a time-based blind SQL injection vulnerability.

item.title: CVE-2026-68068 · 9 CRITICAL — Toptech TMS7 and TopHAT SQL Injection
item.description: The "screenID" parameter in the electronic transaction queue viewer feature within the manual transactions section is susceptible to a time-based blind SQL injection vulnerability.

item.title: CVE-2026-68954 · 9 CRITICAL — Toptech TMS7 and TopHAT SQL Injection
item.description: The "pattern" parameter used in search function in the home page of the TMS application is vulnerable to time-based blind SQL injection vulnerability.

item.title: CVE-2026-63713 · 9 CRITICAL — Toptech TMS7 and TopHAT SQL Injection

item.title: CVE-2026-72510 · 9 CRITICAL — Toptech TMS7 and TopHAT SQL Injection

item.title: CVE-2026-70356 · 9.4 CRITICAL — Toptech TMS7 and TopHAT Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type
item.description: The TMS file upload endpoint fails to enforce server-side file type restrictions, allowing an attacker to upload and execute arbitrary PHP files on the web server.

item.title: CVE-2026-71379 · 10 CRITICAL 🌩️ — Toptech TMS7 and TopHAT Files or Directories Accessible to External Parties
item.description: The file export endpoint allows any unauthenticated attacker to export arbitrary database tables by sending a crafted POST request.
